blocks.title: someone DMs you *"how much?"* which reply actually books the *call*?

vote.incoming: ok this sounds like exactly what i need, how much is it?
options: It's $1,500! Here's my calendar, grab any slot that works for you.
Check the link in my bio, everything is explained there.
Great question! What made you reach out today?
It's $1,500, or 3 payments of $550. Before I send times, how many clients are you working with right now?

blocks.caption: 1, 2, 3 or 4? comment before you swipe, no cheating.

blocks.text: sounds efficient, then your week fills up with calls from people who were never a fit. by thursday you're tired as h\*ll.
you just sent a warm lead out of the chat, right when they wanted to talk. a lot of them never come back to ask twice.
no price, just a question. people smell a script from a mile away. a dodge smells exactly like one.

blocks.title: answer the price, then ask *one* question

blocks.text: the price shows you're honest. **the question keeps the conversation yours.**

the lead answers, because the question is about them. people love talking about themselves. i mean, look at instagram.

and now you know if the call is worth booking.
price answered, one question, two times offered. the call gets booked right in the DM, with the notes already written. you just show up.
